legend.supplemental: adds specialized evidence and does not replace a mandatory role
legend.conditional: runs only when the stated trigger occurs

rows.discovery-auditor: required: independently verify accepted denominator has not drifted before first batch
rows.truth-test-author: required: author the isolated Phase 0 Red contract and negative fixtures
rows.adversarial-reviewer: required: review the freeze, drift report, and truth contract before content dispatch

rows.discovery-auditor: conditional: newly alleged denominator path only, which stops the track

rows.task: Phase 4 scene-usage join, suitability, and disposition

rows.root-coordinator: candidate renderer only after zero blocking findings

rows.root-orchestrator-product-owner: required: exact candidate and review hash decision based on automated, Kimi WebBridge, independent LLM, and direct visual evidence
rows.root-coordinator: accepted-manifest renderer only after evidence-backed owner acceptance

global_rules: Every one of the 12 batches receives separate receipts for each applicable role.
Specialists supplement and never replace discovery-auditor, evidence-collector, requirements-mapper, truth-test-author, or adversarial-reviewer obligations.
An agent with any producer role in a batch cannot be its truth-test author or adversarial reviewer.
The Phase 0 strategy author cannot hold a later factual, interpretive, truth-test, or review role.
No role may expand the denominator, roots, owner authorization, or success-claim boundary.
